An animated page

The clone must freeze this page: the spinner stays put and the video stays paused. Scrolling is what a live clone would repaint on.

Long enough to scroll

Paragraph one. The map is a picture of this page, so the fixture only has to be a page: text, a picture-sized region, and enough height to scroll.

Paragraph two. A clone that keeps animating would repaint forever for no information, which is exactly what the freeze in clone.js prevents.

Paragraph three. The rail scales this into the strip; the preview mounts the same snapshot at the hovered offset.
